dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), developed by NaCl for Japan Medical Association, compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL
evidence: ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED with DYNAMIC/SEQUENTIAL access

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - specifically inpatient admission fee calculation for hospitalization and self-pay receipts
purpose.summary: ORCR0840 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that aggregates and calculates diagnosis/treatment category point scores for inpatient (hospitalization) and self-pay receipts. It reads and writes multiple indexed ISAM files (RECE82, RECE84, RECE85, RECE8A, RECE8B) representing receipt detail records and produces summarized point-score output files used in Japanese national health insurance billing.

notable_features: Multiple indexed files with both DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes
Large working-storage with flag, counter, and index areas
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
282 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese EUC encoding, decoded as latin-1 resulting in mojibake. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA (日医標準レセプトソフト) system. Source truncated at 16000 chars but sufficient evidence for classification. No COMP-3 usage detected despite medical billing context, consistent with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL target platform.
